newsitem.title: FRANCE: French ministry- EU decision lifts GAN uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: French ministry- EU decision lifts GAN uncertainty.

text.p: The French Finance Ministry said on Wednesday that the privatisation of insurer GAN and subsidiary CIC would be conducted with the interest of the firms and state finances in mind.

The ministry said in a statement that approval by the European Commission of a 20-billion-franc state rescue package for GAN -- announced on Wednesday -- removed the uncertainty which had been hanging over the two groups.

The Commission said it had approved the aid on the basis of French commitments to privatise GAN and CIC, to divest strategic shareholdings worth around 2.4 billion francs ($386.1 million) by the end of next year and to sell GAN's UIC and UIS property divisions.
It also said the privatisation of GAN should ensure that the group's business outside France was reduced by 50 percent, to be measured in terms of turnover.

"The finance minister (Dominique Strauss-Kahn) has set the goal for the procedure. The sale of GAN and CIC will be conducted with two concerns in mind, the interests of the companies and their staff and the finances of the state," the finance ministry statement said.
It gave no details on timing for the privatisations.
The Commission said in a statement in Brussels that the privatisation process should start as soon as possible and not later than June 30 1998.
